title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best gyms in Auckland with prices from $15/week. Compare gym memberships in Auckland city and suburbs.
intro: Auckland has a diverse range of gyms to choose from, with options to suit every budget and fitness goal. With prices starting from $15 per week, there's never been a better time to get fit in Auckland. From commuter gyms in the CBD to 24/7 gyms in the suburbs, we've got you covered.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, making it easy to find one that suits your needs. Some popular options include CityFitness, Les Mills, and Jetts Fitness.

sections.heading: Auckland Suburbs with Gym Options
sections.body: Many Auckland suburbs have a range of gym options, including Takapuna, Ponsonby, and Newmarket. These areas often have a mix of independent gyms and franchise locations.

sections.heading: Specific Gym Options in Auckland
sections.body: Some specific gym options to consider in Auckland include the Les Mills gym in the Britomart precinct, and the CityFitness gym on Queen Street.

sections.heading: Finding a Gym with Parking in Auckland
sections.body: For those who drive to the gym, finding a location with parking can be a priority. Many gyms in the suburbs have parking available, while some city gyms may have limited or paid parking options.
